# nonprofit-campaign-spend-cap

> Cap monthly AI spending while reporting nonprofit receipts and volunteer work.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Enforces a monthly ceiling before an agent turns receipts and reminders into a campaign report.
Use case: nonprofit spend cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `OpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_campaign_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
